row.name: admission_applications_decided_check
row.value:
(state <> 'decided' or (decision is not null and released_at is null))
        and (decision is null) = (decided_at is null)

row.name: admission_applications_offered_check
row.value: state <> 'offered' or offer_expires_on is not null

row.name: p_erase_update
row.using:
exists (select 1 from core.admission_applications a
        where a.tenant_id = admission_events.tenant_id and a.id = admission_events.application_id
          and app.erasure_approved(a.tenant_id, a.applicant_user_id))
